did: I had fresh readers try the phone's interview pages cold and score them, and drew up a prototype the owner agreed on. Then I built it. The first page is now a way in: what the week is, its two kinds of practice and what each costs, how a week goes, and a door to this week's takes. A week under way lists what was done, and the words say plainly that what home has at the deadline is what counts. Small words the readers stumbled on now agree with each other: today's question shows its number, a script's countdown shows on the button, Read aloud is now Scripts, and Delete says it deletes only what's on this phone. Past weeks lists each closed week with what was sent and where its video essay is: ready to watch, being made, waiting, couldn't finish, or not written yet.

calls.title: What the interview's first page offers before Past weeks existed
options: Two kinds, How a week goes and a door to the takes, leaving Past weeks and drills out until they exist
Every section from the prototype, some of them empty
calls.why: A section with nothing real behind it would promise what the phone can't do yet.
calls.undo: Add the sections back to the first page in week.tsx once each has something behind it.

calls.title: Where a question's page goes back to
options: Back to Questions, the page that lists it
Back to the first page, as before
calls.why: Today's question moved one layer down, to Questions, so back should return there.
calls.undo: Point the two back links in ladder.tsx at the interview page again.

calls.title: The interview's names from the cold read
options: Name the kind Scripts, number each question by the week's order, count on the button, Delete from this phone
Rename the ladder's Read it aloud step instead, which the owner agreed on Nov 17
Renumber the look over with today's question first, so a take's name changes daily
calls.why: It keeps the owner's agreed ladder names and gives each take a name that doesn't change.
calls.undo: Restore the words in words.ts and drop the numbers in way-in.tsx (C634).

calls.title: How deep Past weeks goes
options: Closed weeks only, each in place on one page
Every week held, the open one included
A list that opens a read-only page per week
calls.why: The open week has the first page; a page per week would repeat what Takes and the essay already show (C660).
calls.undo: Drop the closed-week filter in past.ts, or add a page per week.

calls.title: What Past weeks says about an essay not yet ready
options: Say what the video is doing from home's render board, and promise no day
Say it comes the Monday after the week closes
calls.why: Home promises no day for an interview essay, and may never make one it refused (C661).
calls.undo: Change the essay words in words.ts and essayOf in past.ts.

left: No test renders how the Past weeks page itself loads the essay list and the render board; the tests hand it ready-made rows.
The interview essay feed's name is written twice in the code, in the links and in past.ts; one shared copy in lib/feeds would stop them drifting.
The shared record button's new countdown view is tested only through the interview's own tests.
Home refuses an essay without telling the phone, so such an essay shows as written for good; the words promise nothing because of it.
Decision drills (IW13, #3181) and IW11 and IW12 remain as filed.
